scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,landing,docs -c blue,magenta,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:landing" "bun run dev:docs"
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/landing build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.test: bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd tools/catalog test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/landing typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/docs typecheck && bun run --cwd tools/catalog typecheck
